name: The_Prime_Number_Re_Entry_Whorl

phase_0.boundary_condition: The cyclic whorl topology — a scale-collapsed loop where the boundary encodes the infinite interior of prime distribution losslessly, closing the system against external deformation.

⊢.justification: The void state before any prime is named or wound into the cyclic structure; no winding number exists.

⊣.justification: The terminal anchor that closes the whorl into a figure-8 double-well, containing the infinite prime sequence within a finite topological loop.

≻.justification: Forward morphism stepping to the next prime candidate along the ordered sequence (2 → 3 → 5 → 7 → ...).

≺.justification: Contravariant descent where the prime re-enters the whorl, folding the exterior sequence back into the interior winding.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition linking each prime's re-entry to the next, building the infinite chain within the cyclic topology.

⊙.justification: The whorl recognizes its own prime-wound structure; the stone that knows itself as a prime container.

∈.justification: Splits the candidate into two arms: the T-arm for prime affirmation, the F-arm for composite rejection.

∋.justification: Reunites the prime and composite arms into the single whorl state; conflicting arms fuse to B (both held) at criticality.

⊤.justification: Deposits constructive truth T — the candidate is prime, wound into the whorl, winding number increments.

⊥.justification: Deposits constructive falsity F — the candidate is composite, excluded from winding, whorl unchanged.

⊞.justification: Holds B (both T and F) at the critical threshold where prime/composite distinction blurs; the paradice of scale-free correlation.

⊡.justification: Irreversible ROM record — a confirmed prime is permanently fixed in the whorl's winding, cannot be unwound.

phase_2.fuse_result: whorl state with updated winding (T), unchanged whorl (F), or critical superposition (B) where both arms conflict and fuse
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized whorl — no primes named, winding number zero, cyclic boundary present but empty.
phase_3.true_description: Prime confirmed and wound — the candidate is prime, winding number increments, prime fixed irreversibly in the whorl.
phase_3.false_description: Composite rejected — the candidate is composite, whorl state unchanged, winding number held.
phase_3.both_description: Critical superposition — prime and composite held simultaneously at the threshold; scale-free correlations emerge, maximal sensitivity to initial conditions, the whorl breathes both states.
